3. Cross-Client Security (HTTP Level)

Four HTTP-level tests added (commit aee3d86) proving URL-direct cross-client access returns 404:

  • Admin from Client A requesting Client B warehouse URL → 404
  • Admin from Client A requesting Client B locations URL → 404
  • Unauthenticated warehouse URLs → 302 redirect to /login
  • Unauthenticated user management URLs → 302 redirect to /login

Enforcement mechanism: Eloquent FulfilmentClientScope global scope filters route model binding — independent of middleware.
